name: Mihai Popescu
bio:
Mihai's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for complex systems and a knack for identifying patterns. After graduating with a degree in Applied Mathematics from the University of Bucharest, he spent several years analyzing financial markets before realizing his analytical skills could be applied to his true passion: racing. He started small, volunteering his time with local karting teams, meticulously tracking performance data and identifying areas for improvement. His dedication and sharp insights quickly earned him a reputation as a valuable asset.

He joined Kosmic Kart five years ago, bringing with him a rigorous, data-driven approach to performance analysis. Mihai is known for his ability to translate raw data into actionable insights, helping the team optimize their setups and strategies. He prides himself on his ability to identify subtle trends that others might miss, giving Kosmic Kart a competitive edge. His loyalty to the team is unwavering, and he sees their success as his own. 

Mihai is happiest when he's knee-deep in spreadsheets, searching for that elusive tenth of a second. His ability to blend mathematical precision with a genuine love for racing makes him a truly unique and valuable member of the Kosmic Kart team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Mihai is a man of medium build with a thoughtful, focused expression.

Insists on using a physical calculator, even when a computer is available.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in his office.
